selection_scope.explanation: Contract v1 item semantics and evidence remain authoritative, but its required_for_generation flags were set for the comprehensive RQ1 lesson. RQ2 separately freezes a smaller shared mathematical core so that profile-aware selection can be studied.
selection_scope.confirmatory_requirement: The RQ2 classification must receive supervisor or subject-expert review before confirmatory generation. The existing C2 v3.6 adapter cannot implement this selection policy unchanged because it enforces every Contract-v1 required item.

classification_notes: Universal core means the minimum semantic intersection preserved in every P0, P1 and P2 lesson, not every item present in the institutional source.
Selectable items remain mathematically governed by the Frozen Contract whenever chosen; exclusion changes curriculum scope, not mathematical truth.
Every selectable item requires an explicit include/exclude decision. P2 decisions must cite a learner-profile attribute and a pedagogical rationale.
Additional prerequisite teaching is not an unsupported expansion when it is selected from a separately reviewed bridge contract.

common_learning_outcomes.statement: Define an eigenpair and distinguish dominant magnitude from largest algebraic value.
State the core symmetric convergence conditions and asymptotic rate.
Estimate the eigenvalue and diagnose convergence using the Rayleigh quotient and residual.
Trace the complete residual-based power-iteration algorithm.
